title: Introducing Meme Rush: Discover and Trade Meme Tokens Early on Binance Wallet
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We're excited to introduce  Meme Rush , a new feature in Binance Wallet that provides users with early insight into the latest meme coins sourced from external meme coin launch platforms. Meme Rush allows users to seamlessly discover, track, and trade meme tokens by integrating the respective lists of tokens from two leading Meme Token Launch Platforms onto Binance Wallet: Four.Meme and Pump.Fun.  Four.Meme and Pump.Fun are community-driven meme coin launch platforms for the BNB Smart Chain and Solana, respectively. They enable users to easily create and trade tokens, with listings driven by on-chain activity and community engagement. Tokens gain visibility based on factors like trading volume and social traction, offering users early access to trending meme coins. Using Meme Rush, users can explore the Four.Meme List, which highlights tokens on the BNB Smart Chain, and the Pump.Fun list, featuring Solana-based tokens. How to Access Meme Rush Meme Rush : Located under the [Markets Tab] in the Binance Wallet, Meme Rush offers users the complete experience, making it ideal for discovering new meme tokens.  Swap Page : All tokens from the Meme Rush are available for instant trading via the Swap Interface, providing a seamless trading experience. Discover now! About Meme Rush Tokens launch on Four.Meme and Pump.Fun in three stages, each with their unique characteristics.  New Stage : Top 50 newest tokens which are at the start of their bonding curve, available at lower prices for early adopters. Finalizing Stage : Tokens are nearing the peak of their bonding curve, stabilizing supply and demand. The status is represented on the progress bar. Launched Stage : Tokens have completed their bonding curve, and liquidity will be migrated to DEXs. The full token supply will be available for open trading. For more information on what a Bonding Curve is, please refer to  this page .  Notes : The progress bar displayed with each token reflects the percentage of launch supply that has been completed (0–100%). Once it reaches 100%, the token is considered launched. The full token supply will be available for open trading. Please note that meme tokens, especially those in the Finalizing phases, carry significant risk. Not all tokens will complete the launch process, and users may lose funds when trading early-stage projects.  Four.Meme and Pump.Fun are not platforms which are operated by Binance, and Binance holds no responsibility or liability as to the performance of the tokens displayed on these platforms’ lists. The fact that certain tokens can be found on Meme Rush’s lists should not be construed as advice or a recommendation to invest. Users should conduct their own independent research and carefully consider their investment decisions. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support!
